description: NaGdTiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.90 Å. Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.72 Å. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.56 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Gd and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted edge-sharing OGd₂Ti₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Gd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Gd and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Na and one Ti atom.
